$description: Keylines (library plan wave 1, foundation keylines): the icon keyline shapes on the icon set’s 24-unit grid, as units, and the specimen size. system/keylines.css draws them; platform/dev/keylines.js shows them over a page (?keylines).

keyline-icon-grid.$description: Icon keylines: the icon files’ grid, in units (Material Symbols at optical size 20, drawn on a 24-unit square).

keyline-icon-padding.$description: Icon keylines: the padding inside the grid, in units; the live area is the grid minus this on every side (20 of 24).

keyline-icon-circle.$description: Icon keylines: the circle’s diameter, in units (round shapes fill the live area).

keyline-icon-square.$description: Icon keylines: the square’s side, in units (square shapes look as large as the circle at 18).

keyline-icon-short.$description: Icon keylines: the short side of the portrait and landscape rectangles, in units (the long side is the circle’s 20).

keyline-specimen-size.$description: Keyline specimens: the size an icon keyline drawing is shown at (the 24-unit grid at four times).
